title: Delete N Nodes After M Nodes
description:
Given the `head` of a singly linked list and two positive integers `m` and `n`, traverse the list from the beginning by repeating the following steps until reaching the end:
1. Keep the next `m` nodes (including the current node).
2. Remove the next `n` nodes.

Return the `head` of the modified linked list after all removals.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [1, 10^4].
hints: Walk `m - 1` steps from the start of each kept block to land on the last node to keep.
From that node, advance a second pointer `n` steps forward (stopping early if `null` is reached), then rewire `lastKept.next` to skip the deleted segment.

examples.explanation: Keep [1, 2], delete [3, 4, 5], keep [6, 7], delete [8, 9, 10], keep [11, 12], delete [13].
Keep [1], delete [2, 3, 4], keep [5], delete [6, 7, 8], keep [9], delete [10, 11].
Keeping 3 nodes already reaches the end of the 3-node list, so nothing is deleted.
